Is your child aspiring to the Ivy League or US Top 10?

Today, strong grades and CCA leadership alone are no longer enough. Top universities are looking for clarity, direction, and impact.

Join our US Top 10 Admissions Webinar to learn how to help your child strategically position their profile and stands out in today’s competitive landscape. Hear insights from US Strategist from Columbia University and Singapore recent admit to UC Berkeley and UChicago  !

At this exclusive session, you’ll gain:
✔ What actually makes a strong Top 10 application in today’s admissions landscape
✔ A real success story: from rejection to a US Top 10 acceptance
✔ Common mistakes students make — and how to avoid them
✔ Strategic guidance to strengthen your child's admissions profile

SAVE THE DATE!
📅 16 May 2026 (Saturday)
📍 Live on Zoom
🕚 11AM – 12PM

Limited slots available. Reserve your spot today.

Is your child dreaming of getting into a top US university like an Ivy League school, UC Berkeley, or UChicago — but unsure what it really takes as a student in Singapore?

Join us for an exclusive webinar featuring Jennifer, a US Strategist from Columbia University who has guided students through successful admissions journeys, alongside Ke Yue, a Singaporean student who turned rejection and a gap year into a US Top 10 acceptance!

In this session, you’ll discover:
✔ What actually makes a strong Top 10 application in today’s admissions landscape
✔ A real success story: from rejection to a US Top 10 acceptance
✔ Common mistakes students make — and how to avoid them
✔ The shift from “working hard” to working strategically

Whether your child is just starting the journey or preparing to apply this year, this webinar will give both of you clarity on where your child stands — and what to do next.

Take the next step today and get expert mentorship tailored to your application goals.

Feeling Lost in Your University Applications?

Applying to top universities can be daunting, especially when premium admissions guidance feels out of reach. Sedifly is here to change that. We democratize access to world-class mentorship by connecting you with alumni mentors from elite universities, offering expert advice at a fraction of traditional consultancy costs. With a personalized admissions roadmap, essay reviews, interview prep, and scholarship support tailored to your academic path — whether IB, A-Levels, or Polytechnic — you get clear, structured guidance that reduces stress and amplifies your confidence. 

Click to fill up a form and start your admissions journey with Sedifly!

Get Expert Guidance to Build a Stronger University Application

Ivy League universities don’t just look at grades — they look for well-crafted essays, strong profiles, and a clear personal narrative. Sedifly pairs you with mentors from world-class institutions who know exactly what admissions committees want to see. From refining your essays to strengthening your profile and positioning your achievements strategically, we help you submit a competitive application with confidence. With structured guidance and personalised support, you don’t have to navigate this journey alone — Sedifly helps you get it right the first time.

Take the next step today and get expert mentorship tailored to your application goals.

bodies.text:
Feeling Lost in Your University Applications?

Applying to top universities can be daunting, especially when premium admissions guidance feels out of reach. Sedifly is here to change that. We democratize access to world-class mentorship by connecting you with alumni mentors from elite universities, offering expert advice at a fraction of traditional consultancy costs. With a personalized admissions roadmap, essay reviews, interview prep, and scholarship support tailored to your academic path — whether IB, A-Levels, or Polytechnic — you get clear, structured guidance that reduces stress and amplifies your confidence. 

Click to fill up a form and start your admissions journey with Sedifly!

Get Expert Guidance to Build a Stronger University Application

Ivy League universities don’t just look at grades — they look for well-crafted essays, strong profiles, and a clear personal narrative. Sedifly pairs you with mentors from world-class institutions who know exactly what admissions committees want to see. From refining your essays to strengthening your profile and positioning your achievements strategically, we help you submit a competitive application with confidence. With structured guidance and personalised support, you don’t have to navigate this journey alone — Sedifly helps you get it right the first time.

Take the next step today and get expert mentorship tailored to your application goals.
